api_params.name: base_year
api_params.description: Base year for the index ("2022-23", "2011-12", "2004-05", "1993-94"). If the user does not mention a base year, pass "2022-23". 2022-23 has data from 2023 onwards; for earlier years pass "2011-12" (2012 onwards), "2004-05" (2005-2017) or "1993-94" (1994-2010). Index values and item/group codes differ by base year, so always pass base_year together with code filters.

api_params.name: year
api_params.description: Enter the Year (format YYYY. Comma separated for multiple values)

api_params.name: major_group_code
